items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I got a chance to see some of the guys that were more or less inspiring to me. And one particular fella I had in mind was this Alphonse Piku.

ctx.x: Yeah, I went to church there once.

As a matter of fact, I used to stay right across the street from there, so therefore I had access to the places at various times of the day, and where I'd get a chance to listen to some of the fellas playing and whatnot. And I think it was one of these halls, which when I don't remember, that I got a chance to see some of the guys that were more or less inspiring to me. And one particular fella I had in mind was this Alphonse Piku. However I never had a chance to study under Piku because at that particular time…
Now where did you go to school? Which school did you go to school?
